annotations.title: ISP gesture codes back to IPA / braille

description:
Converts WIA Talk ISP codes (e.g. HS02-LC07-MV01-OR03-MM07) back to IPA and WIA Braille. Unknown codes are listed as missing, never invented. Sound-unit codes, not sign language. (pronunciation-based, NOT an official national braille code.)
한국어: ISP 코드를 IPA·점자로 되돌립니다.

codes.description: ISP codes such as HS02-LC07-MV01-OR03-MM07; " " marks a word boundary

lang.description: ISO language code, e.g. ko, en, ja. If omitted the API auto-detects; call braille_languages for supported codes

name: talk_codes_to_text
